subject: general
question: If 6 men and 8 boys can do a piece of work in 10 days, while 26 men and 48 boys can do the same in 2 days, the time taken by 25 boys in doing the same type of work will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using **M₁D₁ = M₂D₂**: (6M + 8B) × 10 = (26M + 48B) × 2

⇒ 30M + 40B = 26M + 48B ⇒ 4M = 8B ⇒ **1M = 2B**

Total work in terms of boys: (6 × 2B + 8B) × 10 = 20B × 10 = 200 units

Time for 25 boys = 200 ÷ 25 = 8 days

**∴ The correct answer is 8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Case 1 = 6 men and 8 boys in 10 days; Case 2 = 26 men and 48 boys in 2 days.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = Efficiency × Time

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 6M + 8B 10 200 
 26M + 48B 2 200 100 

⇒ (6M + 8B) × 10 = (26M + 48B) × 2

⇒ 60M + 80B = 52M + 96B

⇒ 8M = 16B ⇒ 1M = 2B

⇒ Total Work = (6(2B) + 8B) × 10 = 200B

⇒ Required Time = 200B ÷ 25B = 8 days

**∴ The correct answer is 8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Man-Day Formula

The general formula is (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) / W₂, where M is men, D is days, H is hours, and W is work.

Efficiency Ratio

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. If the ratio of efficiency is x:y, the ratio of time taken is y:x.</p
